# grafana

Grafana, wired to whichever metrics, logs and traces backends the cluster has.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-interface.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-floe-docs -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| autoLogin | boolean | `false` | Skip the login form and go straight to the issuer.  Also disables the form, so a lab that turns this on and then loses its issuer has no way in at all. Off by default for that reason.  |
| chart | string | *(required)* | Store path of the Grafana Helm chart. Required. |
| namespace | string | `"monitoring"` | Namespace Grafana runs in. |
| oidc | boolean | `false` | Log in through the lab's OIDC issuer.  Off by default: with nothing providing OIDC_PROVIDER this is refused rather than silently falling back to the admin password, and most labs that run Grafana do not run an issuer.  |
| storage | string | `"2Gi"` | Size of the volume dashboards and settings live on. |

## Requires

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cluster | KUBERNETES_CLUSTER | The cluster a member installs into: its name, version, context and address ranges. |
| gateway | API_GATEWAY | An ingress a workload attaches an HTTPRoute to, and the zone its hostnames live in. |
| generation | SECRET_GENERATION | A controller that mints secret values in the cluster, so none is rendered into a manifest. |

## Requires, optionally

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| logs | LOG_INGEST | Where logs are pushed and queried. |
| metrics | METRICS_INGEST | Where metrics are written and queried, and the monitoring CRDs a consumer may use. |
| oidc | OIDC_PROVIDER | An OIDC issuer, its endpoints, and the CR a consumer registers a client with. |
| traces | TRACE_INGEST | Where traces are sent and queried. |
